title: 第九章 招摇城隍
content_zh:
“根据我以往的经验，在食物充足，组织得体的情况下，这种情况几乎不会发生。我刚看了城内的布置，应该没有问题？”墨非夜身为墨者，参加和听闻的守城案例数不胜数。这么快就有骚乱苗头，肯定是不正常的。

    “我起初以为是有人煽动，调查后发现不是。”招摇侯说道。

    “哇，城隍庙。”芊芊突然停了下来，仿佛发现了新大陆一般，兴奋地叫道，然后跑了进去。

    华族对城隍庙，有着严格按照礼制标准。眼前的城隍庙，也都是由青砖为墙，配上黄色琉璃瓦建造而成。

    在城隍庙的神台上，端坐着一位身穿金色鱼鳞甲，手扶阔剑的大胡子武将。因为城隍的主要责任是扫荡阴邪，保一方平安，因此大多城隍爷的形象，都是怒目圆睁，凶神恶煞。

    城隍庙内，香火鼎盛，一堆堆的立香放在桌子上，免费供人使用。

    “这是城内善人所捐，免费供人使用，用来报答城隍爷护佑城民。”招摇侯微笑地指着香炉对墨非夜说道。

    芊芊已经凑完热闹，给城隍上完香，挤到墨非夜身边说道“这香比我以前见过的，要好闻些。”

    招摇侯调侃道：“芊芊姑娘，哪有岂不是更多，城隍爷更喜欢些，多吸些香火，也好多护佑我等。”

    一座城市，只有龙脉的滋养，是远远不够的。比如现在招摇城，到现在都没有被攻破，其主要原因，龙脉有一方面原因，但是这个比例极小，

    主要原因是没有高阶厌火出现，如果出现高阶厌火，直接冲入城内，凭城里士的水平，完全无法招架。招摇城的情况，也是夏人大多数城池的缩影。

    于是在漫长的战争中，夏人为了解决这一问题，产生了一套完整的战斗系统。

    夏人会将以往的英烈或者道德楷模封神，为他们重塑金身，享受香火供奉，从而继续护佑九州。

    城隍就是这样产生，城隍有很强的地域性，他们一般生前都是本地人，或者是对本地有特殊贡献的人。在他们死后，会以本地的泥为肉，草为骨，加上本人遗物或者遗骨，为他们重塑金身，再加上夏后的册封诏书，就这样一个城隍就诞生了。

    这样城隍就城池合为一体，享受香火，从而守护城池，化解怨气，消灭邪祟。

    招摇城的城隍，生前是一名大将，因为当年与羽人的作战中，坚守城池死战不退，世人感其忠勇，就此时被封为招摇城隍。

    一群人刚从城隍庙走出，迎面走过来一名年轻人，身穿破旧青衫，和手中的长幡上，没有像其他算命那样，写上未卜先知，料事如神之类的话。只是简单写了一个“无”。

    双方本来都已擦肩而过，算命先生却又折了回来，将众人一番打量后，站到了芊芊面前：“姑娘，观你根骨惊奇，貌美如花，天资聪颖，沉鱼落雁，温婉贤淑，曲眉丰颊，螓首蛾眉，水木清华，赏心悦目，天生丽质，将来必定能嫁个如意郎君，婚姻美满，举案齐眉，子孙满堂。”

    “去，去。”招摇侯明显对此人很是厌恶。

    “唉”算命先生看了招摇侯一眼，发出一声长叹。

    芊芊看起来心情却不错，从袖中掏出一点银子，直接丢过去：“下次再遇到，这种话多说点。”

    算命先生刚准备开口，就看到隍庙内飞出一道金光，直落城头。

    城隍庙内的神台上，只剩下一把空荡荡的椅子，满城民众皆跪地参拜。

    城隍爷显灵了！
content_en:
"According to my past experience, if there is sufficient food and proper organization, this situation will almost never happen. I just looked at the layout of the city, there should be no problem?" As a Mo Mo, Mo Feiye has participated in and heard of countless cases of city defense. It is certainly abnormal for there to be signs of riots so soon.

    "I initially thought it was someone who was inciting the incident, but after investigation I found it was not the case," said Zhao Yaohou.

    "Wow, City God's Temple." Qianqian suddenly stopped, as if she had discovered a new world, she shouted excitedly, and then ran in.

    The Chinese have strict etiquette standards for the City God's Temple. The City God's Temple in front of you is also built with blue brick walls and yellow glazed tiles.

    On the altar of the City God's Temple, there sat a bearded general wearing golden fish scale armor and holding a broad sword. Because the main responsibility of the City God is to eliminate evil and ensure peace, most images of the City God have angry eyes and a fierce look.

    In the Chenghuang Temple, incense is in full bloom, and piles of standing incense are placed on the table for free use.

    "This is donated by good people in the city. It is free for people to use. It is used to repay the city god for protecting the people of the city." Zhao Yaohou pointed to the incense burner and said to Mo Feiye with a smile.

    Qianqian had already joined in the fun and offered incense to the City God. She squeezed in next to Mo Feiye and said, "This incense smells better than what I have seen before."

    Zhao Yaohou joked: "Miss Qianqian, there are more of them. The City God likes them more. If you smoke more incense, you will protect us more."

    It is not enough for a city to only be nourished by dragon veins. For example, Zhaoyao City has not been breached until now. The main reason for this is Dragon Vein, but this ratio is extremely small.

    The main reason is that no high-level fire-weary people appear. If high-level fire-weary people appear, they will rush directly into the city. Based on the level of the city soldiers, they will be completely unable to parry. The situation in Zhaoyao City is also a microcosm of most Xia people's cities.

    So in the long war, the Xia people developed a complete combat system in order to solve this problem.

    The Xia people would enshrine heroes or moral models in the past as gods, reshape their golden bodies, enjoy incense and offerings, and continue to protect Kyushu.

    This is how City Gods came into being. City Gods have a strong sense of locality. They were usually locals during their lifetime, or people who made special contributions to the local area. After their death, local mud would be used as flesh, grass as bones, personal relics or bones would be added to reshape their golden bodies, and the canonization edict of the Xia Queen would be added, and a city god would be born.

    In this way, the city god becomes one with the city and enjoys the incense, thus protecting the city, resolving grievances and eliminating evil spirits.

    The City God of Zhaoyao City was a general during his lifetime. Because he defended the city and refused to retreat during the battle with the Yuren, the world recognized his loyalty and bravery, and was named the City God of Zhaoyao City.

    A group of people had just walked out of the City God's Temple, and a young man walked towards them. He was wearing a shabby green shirt and the long flag in his hand did not have any words like other fortune tellers, such as predicting the future and predicting events like gods. Just simply write "none".

    Both parties had already passed by each other, but the fortune teller came back again. After looking at everyone, he stood in front of Qianqian and said, "Girl, I am amazed to see you. You are as beautiful as a flower, you are talented, and you are so deep." Yu Luoyan, gentle and virtuous, with curved eyebrows and plump cheeks, a green head and green eyebrows, pleasing to the eye, and natural beauty, will definitely marry a good man in the future, have a happy marriage, have a happy marriage, and have many descendants. "

    "Go, go." Zhao Yaohou was obviously disgusted with this person.

    "Alas" the fortune teller glanced at Zhao Yaohou and let out a long sigh.

    Qianqian seemed to be in a good mood. She took out some money from her sleeve and threw it directly: "Next time we meet, say more like this."

    Just as the fortune teller was about to speak, he saw a golden light flying out of the Temple of God and falling straight to the top of the city.

    There was only one empty chair left on the altar in the City God's Temple, and people all over the city knelt down to worship.

    The City God appears!
title_en: Chapter 9: Showing off the City God
